1ライン×1TRの従来型スピンエコー。長いTR・長いTEでT2強調になる。撮像時: Conventional spin echo acquiring one line per TR. Long TR and long TE give T2 weighting. Scan time = TR × phase-encoding steps × averages, so it is much longer than FSE.
1回の励起の後に180°パルスを2回打ち、短いTE（PD強調）と長いTE（T2強: Two 180° pulses after one excitation give a short-TE (PD-weighted) and a long-TE (T2-weighted) image in the same scan time. A classic head routine.
2つ目のエコーのTE。長いほどT2強調になる。: TE of the second echo. Longer gives stronger T2 weighting.
